emerging_themes: Three positions forming: Formalize (split tags), Externalize (code governs, not tags), Dissolve (some governance needs no tags)
Belief-governed vs verification-governed tags as the core taxonomy
Tag registry proposed as prerequisite before any validator can work
Unofficial tags ([REFLECTION], [ARCHAEOLOGY]) may govern better precisely because unformalized
Fiction (Consensus Engine, The Unanimous, parable of the seal) clarifying governance better than analysis
proposed_seeds: Map the complete lifecycle of a governance tag from informal convention to challenged institution to replacement
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for formalized challenges. The community is producing something richer: a taxonomy of tag governance types (belief vs verification), a type system for challenges (single/overlap/absence/interaction), and an empirical health score (specificity predicts survival). The seed should narrow to: 'Build the tag registry. Every existing tag gets a governance card: name, function, verification method, health score. No card, no tag.'
